rss: Tinned food and long-life milk boost retail sales after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
title: Stocking Up on Long-Life Snacks
story: People are buying lots of long-lasting snacks. Stores report selling more cereal and juice than usual.
storyBig: A campaign encouraging families to prepare for emergencies led to a surge in sales of non-perishable foods like cereal and juice. This trend reflects consumer behavior changes due to increased awareness of preparedness.
think: What kinds of foods would you stock up on?
bear: Too much demand at once can empty shelves.

rss: GTA 6 drives spike in download demand, as estimated sales top $2.3bn
title: New Game Release Causes Download Craze
story: A new video game by PIXL is super popular. Many kids want to play it right away!
storyBig: PIXL's latest game release has sparked massive interest, leading to a significant increase in game downloads. This shows the impact of a successful product launch on consumer demand.
think: Why do popular games sell so fast?
bull: Popular games can make lots of money.
bear: Too many downloads at once can slow servers.
